0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, 0-2 on the road, on a five-game losing streak) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 2-2 at home, coming off a loss) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, the Jazz's ninth of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Dallas won the most recent meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17.
